mercimek.name: Miya da Lenti
mercimek.description: Miyan lenti da aka yi a gida bisa salon gargajiya, an kammala da miya mai man shanu.

tas-kebabi.name: Stew na Nama na Ture
tas-kebabi.description: Nama, kayan lambu na kakar, da miya ta musamman da gidan cin abincinmu ya dahu a hankali.

kuzu-tandir.name: Ragon da Aka Yi Roasted Sannu
kuzu-tandir.description: Ragon tandoori na musamman na gidan cin abincinmu, an dafa shi a hankali a kan ƙaramin zafi.

pirinc-pilavi.name: Shinkafa Pilaf
pirinc-pilavi.description: Shinkafa pilaf mai laushi da man shanu, iri Baldo.

firin-sutlac.name: Budadden Pudding na Shinkafa
firin-sutlac.description: Pudding na shinkafa da aka gasa a hanyar gargajiya, an shirya shi da madarar buffalo ta yau da kullum.

kuru-fasulye.name: Miya Farar Wake da Nama
kuru-fasulye.description: Wake irin İspir, naman sa da aka yanka kanana, da man tumatir na gidan cin abinci.

izgara-kofte.name: Kwadon Nama a Gasa
izgara-kofte.description: Kwadon naman sa irin na dukan nama da barkono da tumatir da aka gasa.

ayran.name: Ayran da Aka Hura
ayran.description: Sauki na gargajiya da aka hura mai kumfa, wanda aka yi da yogurt na yau da kullum.

ezogelin-corbasi.name: Miyan Ezogelin
ezogelin-corbasi.description: Miya ta gargajiya ta gidan cin abinci inda lentils ja, bulgur, da shinkafa suka hadu da minti.

tarhana-corbasi.name: Miyan Tarhana
tarhana-corbasi.description: Tarhana na gida, wani tsohon abincin Anatoliya da aka dafa a hankali tare da tumatir da minti busasshe.

yayla-corbasi.name: Yogurt da Shinkafa Miya
yayla-corbasi.description: Miya mai sanyaya jiki da kirim wanda aka shirya da yogurt, shinkafa, da busasshen minti.

iskembe-corbasi.name: Miyan Tripe
iskembe-corbasi.description: Miyan naman sa na tripe daidai gwargwado tare da kayan yaji da ruwan tafarnuwa.

dugun-corbasi.name: Miyan Biki
dugun-corbasi.description: Miyan biki na gargajiya wanda aka yi da naman rago da aka yayyanka kuma aka yi masa ɗanɗano da ruwan lemun tsami.

tavuk-suyu-corbasi.name: Miyan Bulon Kaza
tavuk-suyu-corbasi.description: Miyan warkarwa da aka shirya da tsinken taliya da aka dafa a cikin bulon kasusuwa da naman kaza da aka yayyanka.

domates-corbasi.name: Miyan Tumatir
domates-corbasi.description: ɗanɗano mai yalwa da aka dafa tare da tumatir da ya yi tsatsa, man shanu, da basil, an kammala shi da cuku.

sebze-corbasi.name: Miya na kayan lambu
sebze-corbasi.description: Miya mai haske ta gidan cin abinci da aka shirya da kayan lambu na kakar, man zaitun, da ganye sabo.

beyran-corbasi.name: Miya mai zafi na naman rago Beyran
beyran-corbasi.description: Miya ta yanki da aka shirya a kan zafi mai yawa da naman rago, shinkafa, tafarnuwa, da barkono mai zafi.

kelle-paca-corbasi.name: Miya na kai da ƙafa
kelle-paca-corbasi.description: Miya mai yalwa da kasusuwa da aka yi da ƙafafen saniya da nama na kai da aka dafa na tsawon sa'o'i.

sehriye-corbasi.name: Miya na Vermicelli
sehriye-corbasi.description: Miya ta yau da kullum an shirya ta da ruwan gàjiya na kaza da tumatir, vermiselli, da parsley.

tavuk-sis.name: Skewers na Kaza
tavuk-sis.description: Sassan kaza da aka jika da kayan yaji na musamman, ana miya da barkono da tumatir da aka soya.

kasap-sucuk.name: Sucuk na Makin Yankan Nama da aka Gasa
kasap-sucuk.description: Chorizo mai yaji na naman sa da aka dafa a kan gawayi, tare da kayan lambu da albasa da sumac.

karisik-izgara.name: Gasa Haɗi
karisik-izgara.description: Faranti mai yawan abinci da aka haɗa wanda ya ƙunshi kuxin nama, skewers na kaza, ƙasƙar naman rago, da chorizo.

nohut-yemegi.name: Stew na Chickpea da Naman Sa
nohut-yemegi.description: Abincin gida na wake da nama yankakke a hankali a cikin tukunya ta tagulla.

patlican-musakka.name: Moussaka na Aubergine
patlican-musakka.description: Aubergine mai soyayye, nama ƙasa, da moussaka da aka gasa a cikin murhu tare da miya tumatir, salon gidan abinci.

zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.name: Wake Kore a Man Zaitun
zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.description: Abincin gargajiya da aka dafa a man zaitun tare da wake kore, tumatir, da albasa, ana miƙa shi sanyi.

tavuk-sote.name: Kaji Sautéed
tavuk-sote.description: Yankakken ƙananan kaza ana sautéed su a kan zafi mai yawa tare da barkono masu launuka, namomin ƙasa, da tumatir.

izmir-kofte.name: Kuli-Kuli na Ƙasar İzmir
izmir-kofte.description: Babban abincin gargajiya na ƙwallon naman sa, dankalin turawa, da barkono da aka gasa a cikin miya tumatir.

etli-bezelye.name: Wake da Naman Sa
etli-bezelye.description: Abincin yau da kullum da ake dafa shi a tukunya tare da yankakken naman sa, wake, karas, da dankalin turawa.

patlican-oturtma.name: Aubergine da Naman Kasa
patlican-oturtma.description: An shirya harshe a cikin tanda tare da aubergine, nama mai yaji da aka nika, da miya tumatir mai tafarnuwa.

salgam-suyu.name: Ruwan Lalacewar Danya
salgam-suyu.description: Ruwan danye mai yaji na gargajiya da aka lalata tare da karas launin shunayya da yis na bulgur.

maden-suyu.name: Ruwan Maɗaukaki
maden-suyu.description: Ruwan maɗaukaki na halitta mara ƙamshi da aka bayar sanyi.

su.name: Ruwa na Spring na Halitta
su.description: Ruwan spring na halitta da aka yi sanyi an jera shi a cikin kwalban gilashi.

kola.name: Cola
kola.description: Shayin lemu mai ƙwanƙwasa na gargajiya da aka yi sanyi sosai.

gazoz.name: Ruwan Lemu na Turkiyya
gazoz.description: Ruwan soda na gargajiya mai ɗanɗano, mai sanyaya jiki, da aka yi sanyi ba tare da ƙari ba.

turk-kahvesi.name: Kofi na Turkiyya
turk-kahvesi.description: Kofi na Turkiyya na gargajiya mai kumfa, da aka dafa a kan zafi mai yawa a cikin cezve na tagulla.

demleme-cay.name: Shayi na Turkiyya da aka dafa
demleme-cay.description: Shayi mai zafi na Rize da aka dafa kwanan nan a cikin gilashi mai kugu.

ev-yapimi-limonata.name: Lemonaid na Gida
ev-yapimi-limonata.description: Lemun tsami mai daɗi ana haɗa shi a kowace rana da sabbin lemun tsami, minti, da ɗan sukari kaɗan.

hosaf.name: Kwaron 'Ya'yan itace na Rana
hosaf.description: Kwaron gida da aka tafasa a kowace rana tare da raisins, apricots, ko plums bisa ga yanayin lokaci.

iskender-kebabi.name: Bursa İskender Kebab
iskender-kebabi.description: Namijin yana juyawa a kan skewer a saman pide, ana yi masa hidima da miya tumatir, man zafi, da yogurt.

kazandibi.name: Puding Madara Mai Kirim
kazandibi.description: Na gargajiya pudding madara wanda aka caramelize da kyau, da laushi mai laushi.

tavuk-gogsu.name: Puding Madaran Ottoman
tavuk-gogsu.description: Wani kayan zaki mai haske da kumfa wanda ake dafa shi da girke-girke na gargajiya, ana kawo shi tare da kirfa.

keskul.name: Kwade-kwaden Madarar Almond
keskul.description: Kayan zaki na madara na salon Ottoman wanda aka kammala da ɗanɗano almond da kwakwa.

irmik-helvasi.name: Halva na Semolina
irmik-helvasi.description: Halva na semolina, wanda aka soya da man shanu da kanwa, ana kawo shi da zafi da tsaba.

kabak-tatlisi.name: Kayan Zaki na Kabewa tare da Tahini
kabak-tatlisi.description: Kabewa, wadda aka dafa a hankali a ruwanta, ana kawo ta tare da tahini da gyada.

ayva-tatlisi.name: Kayan Zaki na Ayaba
ayva-tatlisi.description: Ayaba da aka dafa tare da ɗanɗano na clove da kirfa ana kawo ta tare da madara mai kauri da gyada.

revani.name: Kafin Kayan Zaki na Semolina
revani.description: Kayan zaki na gargajiya na gidan cin abinci inda kayan cake mai laushi na semolina yake haduwa da syrup mai kamshin lemon.

ekmek-kadayifi.name: Pudding Na Burodi da Cream Mai Kaushi
ekmek-kadayifi.description: Pudding na burodi da aka ajiye tare da syrup caramelized ana yi masa hidima tare da cream mai kaushi na buffalo.

cevizli-baklava.name: Baklava na Walnut
cevizli-baklava.description: Layer da aka shimfida sosai, baklava mai karko da aka yi da yawa walnuts da man shanu na gargajiya.
